industry.why: Neutral, carried. Component 1 regime, 23-Oct-26 (risk-off confirmed and broadening: the discount-rate squeeze now a positioning wash-out in the artificial intelligence complex with credit leading it, bonds rallied as a hedge for the first time this cycle while the Fed still hikes in December, the US 10-year near 5.10%, Brent $111, French sovereign stress spilling into Italy, European defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows and breadth in the bottom fifth of three years; sources present 2026-W43): Jefferies' desk (17 Oct) names utilities with staples as 'pricing-power defensives' and utilities led the US week, which is the defensive case; against it, utilities are the classic bond proxy, the Fed hikes in December and no European power price was read. Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-23 against 2026-08-21, not week on week: D now, D prior. Integrated generators and regulated networks stay C at sector level, renewable generators D.

sector.why: Neutral, carried. Component 1 regime, 23-Oct-26 (risk-off confirmed and broadening: the discount-rate squeeze now a positioning wash-out in the artificial intelligence complex with credit leading it, bonds rallied as a hedge for the first time this cycle while the Fed still hikes in December, the US 10-year near 5.10%, Brent $111, French sovereign stress spilling into Italy, European defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows and breadth in the bottom fifth of three years; sources present 2026-W43): Jefferies' desk (17 Oct) names utilities among the 'pricing-power defensives' and utilities led the US week; against it, networks are the purest bond proxy, the Fed hikes in December, and no European power price or regulator decision was read. Relative strength per 31-relative-strength.md, 2026-10-23 against 2026-08-21, not week on week: D now, C prior. Moves to B on a power-price reading in the sources or on the bond rally becoming a trend.

geography.why: Neutral, carried, with the evidence for a view named and judged thin. Goldman (19 Oct) names the UK index among those rallying with non-AI, low-beta exposures; its UK Weekly Kickstart 'The Value of Earnings' and the podcast 'The cavalry isn't coming: UK stocks' were titles only; the Bank of England and gilt yields were not read. One clause of index leadership on a 191-stock row, the largest in the table, is not a country view. Component 1 regime, 23-Oct-26 (risk-off confirmed and broadening: the discount-rate squeeze now a positioning wash-out in the artificial intelligence complex with credit leading it, bonds rallied as a hedge for the first time this cycle while the Fed still hikes in December, the US 10-year near 5.10%, Brent $111, French sovereign stress spilling into Italy, European defensives leading cyclicals on all five windows and breadth in the bottom fifth of three years; sources present 2026-W43). Relative strength is not graded by country. Moves to B if a second source makes the UK case with a rate path read.
